response.rationale: C1 and R1 share the same medication-exposure and dystonic posturing evidence. C1 is preferred because it adds the acute subtype, supported by the temporal escalation of the new medication and same-day readmission; R1 is the same core diagnosis without that subtype. The overlapping restatements are discounted.
